steps.prompt: Before the check: which pattern from Multiplication Anchors do you use most, and which do you still have to think about?
steps.placeholder: I use… I still think about…

cards.title: Anchors: quick review
cards.body: Times $10$ moves the digits left; times $5$ is half of times $10$; times $2$ is a double. Build the rest: $\times 6 = \times 5 + \times 1$, $\times 9 = \times 10 - \times 1$, $\times 4$ = double, double.

cards.title: Bigger numbers: quick review
cards.body: Split the bigger number into tens and ones, multiply each part, then add: $23 \times 4 = 80 + 12 = 92$.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First a short warm-up. Then the check: $8$ questions, easiest first, no hints. Type each answer. You need all $8$ right to pass. If you miss one, you’ll see how to do it, and the next try gives you new numbers.

prompts: Where could you use a pattern from Multiplication Anchors outside school?
Which pattern will you keep practising until it is automatic?
